Container.Name: burrow
Container.Overview: Self-hosted static hosting with a CLI. Publish HTML sites, Markdown documents, and other static files at a shareable URL. Deploys expire after 30 days by default, with optional passwords, custom expiry, and replacement at the same URL. [br][br] Set a deploy token before installing. On your computer, configure the Burrow CLI with that token and your server URL. Burrow has no management dashboard; use the CLI to deploy and open the URL it returns. [br][br] The default host port is 47831. For public links, point your reverse proxy at this server and port, configure a domain and HTTPS, and allow request bodies at least as large as the upload limit. See the project README for CLI setup. [br][br] Made by Moon Bunny: https://moonbunny.io
Container.ExtraSearchTerms: static hosting html markdown deploy cli

Config.Name: HTTP port
Config.Description: Host port for uploads and hosted files. Change it if already in use.

Config.Name: Appdata
Config.Description: Persistent storage for deployed files and their settings. Use a dedicated directory.

Config.Name: Deploy tokens
Config.Description: Required. Generate a token with openssl rand -hex 32 and use it as BURROW_TOKEN in the CLI. For multiple tokens, separate them with commas and no spaces.

Config.Name: Upload limit (MB)
Config.Description: Maximum upload size in MB. Extracted content is limited to ten times this value. Match your reverse proxy's request body limit.

Config.Name: Hide footer
Config.Description: 0 shows the Moon Bunny footer on Markdown previews and sign-in pages; 1 hides it.
